runtime_notes.shared_hair_on_kai: All 8 modular hairstyles bind strictly to the 65-bone RunnerRig. Because pony.1..3 rest-pose Z differs by 12.2 cm between lyra_v2 (high ponytail) and kai_v2 (nape), shared styles with pony weights (hair_ponytail, hair_long_layered, hair_curtain_wave) should either recompute boneInverses from target rest pose or keep pony.1..3 translation delta zero when worn on kai_v2.
runtime_notes.winter_tinting: All 3 NPC winter outerwear GLBs expose exact materials WinterCoat, WinterScarf, WinterTrousers, WinterBoots with vertex-color AO on COLOR_0 for per-NPC coat/scarf tinting.
runtime_notes.cast_v2_morphs: lyra_v2 and kai_v2 default (0.0) to semi-realistic human proportions harmonizing with Echo Life NPCs; sculpt_stylized (index 19) blends smoothly to classic stylized proportions; indices 0..18 preserve exact 19 FACS expressions; indices 20..38 provide 19 CC0 Vitruvian anatomical sculpt sliders.
